sentence_stem: If I had studied harder at school,
correct_completion: I would be in a better job now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder at school, I would be in a better job now.
acceptable_variants: I would be earning more money now.
I would have more career options today.

options.text: I will be in a better job tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' and 'tomorrow' do not fit a mixed conditional, which needs 'would' plus a present-time result.

options.text: I am in a better job now.
options.why_wrong: This is a plain present statement; it does not give the result of the imagined past condition.

options.text: I would be in a better job now.
I was in a better job then.
options.why_wrong: This describes a past situation and ignores the condition, so it does not complete the conditional sentence.

explanation: Mixed conditionals link a past condition to a present result. The if-clause uses the past perfect ('had' plus past participle), and the main clause uses 'would' plus base form to describe the present.
translation: Se eu tivesse estudado mais na escola, eu estaria em um emprego melhor agora.
